segments.text:
The elder,
To the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in the truth — and not I alone, but also all who know the truth —

text:
The elder,
To the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in the truth — and not I alone, but also all who know the truth —

segments.text: because of the truth that abides in us and will be with us forever:

text: because of the truth that abides in us and will be with us forever:

segments.text: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and from Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, will be with us in truth and love.

text: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and from Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, will be with us in truth and love.

segments.text: I was overjoyed to find some of your children walking in the truth, just as the Father has commanded us.

text: I was overjoyed to find some of your children walking in the truth, just as the Father has commanded us.

segments.text: And now I urge you, dear lady — not as a new commandment to you, but one we have had from the beginning — that we love one another.

text: And now I urge you, dear lady — not as a new commandment to you, but one we have had from the beginning — that we love one another.

segments.text: And this is love, that we walk according to His commandments. This is the very commandment you have heard from the beginning, that you must walk in love.

text: And this is love, that we walk according to His commandments. This is the very commandment you have heard from the beginning, that you must walk in love.

segments.text: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, refusing to confess the coming of Jesus Christ in the flesh. Any such person is the deceiver and the antichrist.

text: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, refusing to confess the coming of Jesus Christ in the flesh. Any such person is the deceiver and the antichrist.

segments.text: Watch yourselves, so that you do not lose what we have worked for, but that you may be fully rewarded.

text: Watch yourselves, so that you do not lose what we have worked for, but that you may be fully rewarded.

segments.text: Anyone who runs ahead without remaining in the teaching of Christ does not have God. Whoever remains in His teaching has both the Father and the Son.

text: Anyone who runs ahead without remaining in the teaching of Christ does not have God. Whoever remains in His teaching has both the Father and the Son.

segments.text: If anyone comes to you but does not bring this teaching, do not receive him into your home or even greet him.

text: If anyone comes to you but does not bring this teaching, do not receive him into your home or even greet him.

segments.text: Whoever greets such a person shares in his evil deeds.

text: Whoever greets such a person shares in his evil deeds.

segments.text: I have many things to write to you, but I would prefer not to do so with paper and ink. Instead, I hope to come and speak with you face to face, so that our joy may be complete.

text: I have many things to write to you, but I would prefer not to do so with paper and ink. Instead, I hope to come and speak with you face to face, so that our joy may be complete.

segments.text: The children of your elect sister send you greetings.

text: The children of your elect sister send you greetings.
